content.title: 4 Promotional Villas and Network Works
summary: A residential development of four private promotional villas in Rouiba, executed under a comprehensive all-trades package (TCE) including integrated roads and utility networks (VRD).
The project coordinates structural concrete works, contemporary facade articulation, and dedicated site access within a compact suburban footprint.
description: SARL Igloo Yapi Construction executed the complete construction of these four individual dwellings, managing the entire scope from reinforced-concrete structural framing to internal and external finishes. The civil works package integrated essential site grading, pedestrian pathways, and direct connections to municipal utility networks.

The architectural massing employs clean, rectilinear volumes with recessed glazing and integrated pergolas. This layout optimizes solar shading and maintains residential privacy while maximizing the usable outdoor circulation space on each individual plot.
content.authority: Delivered as a complete all-trades package, this residential scheme demonstrates precise coordination between structural execution, exterior envelope finishes, and site-level utility integration.

faq.question: What is the scope of the Rouiba residential project?
faq.answer: The project comprises the construction of four private promotional villas in Rouiba, delivered with complete all-trades execution and integrated site utility networks.

faq.question: What civil and structural works were executed on site?
faq.answer: The contract covered reinforced-concrete structural framing, interior and exterior finishes, MEP installations, and the complete roads and utility networks (VRD) package.

faq.question: How is the site layout configured?
faq.answer: The development coordinates individual villa footprints with dedicated pedestrian and vehicular access routes, optimizing privacy and circulation within a compact suburban site.
